title: Registry lifecycle states with doctor integration
description: WHY: the global board and aggregator need to know which projects to refresh, which are intentionally dormant, and which are gone - otherwise the dashboard fills with dead repos and the aggregator burns cycles on missing paths. Today registry doctor detects drift but only as warnings. WHAT: add a lifecycle field to ProjectRegistryEntry with states linked, paused, archived, missing - additive schema change with migration defaulting existing entries to linked. registry doctor promotes path-gone drift to the missing state (and back to linked when the path reappears); bwrk global pause and resume (or registry set-state) flips paused; unlink sets archived. The aggregator contract (sprint G4) will refresh only linked entries. Surface lifecycle in registry list and the global dashboard payload.
acceptanceCriteria: Lifecycle state round-trips through registry list --json and survives doctor runs
registry doctor marks a moved-away project missing and restores linked when the path returns, covered by tests
closedReason: Registry lifecycle states are implemented, surfaced, validated, and checkpointed.
